artworks.title: Penelope Unraveling Her Web
artworks.description: By a single lamp the queen picks the day's weaving apart while Telemachus sleeps and Odysseus' armour gleams in the dark — the nightly untelling that holds a kingdom in suspension.

artworks.title: Penelope and the Suitors
artworks.description: Waterhouse's Penelope and the Suitors — the hall Telemachus must face before sailing to seek news of his father.

artworks.title: Telemachus and Mentor
artworks.description: Monnet's Telemachus and Mentor — Athena in disguise urging the prince against the devouring suitors.

artworks.title: The Sorrow of Telemachus
artworks.description: Kauffman's Sorrow of Telemachus — the prince's despair under the suitors' siege of his house.

artworks.title: Telemachus Departing from Nestor
artworks.description: Howard's Telemachus departing from Nestor — the Telemachy road that begins the fight to reclaim Ithaca.

popCulture.title: Telemachus
popCulture.description: The son who must grow into a man under the suitors' eyes — the Telemachy as coming-of-age before the slaughter.

popCulture.title: Suitors of Penelope
popCulture.description: Telemachus' assembly speech and the wooers' mockery open the Odyssey's political wound — a house without its king.

popCulture.title: The Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Andrei Konchalovsky
popCulture.description: The miniseries gives Telemachus screen time among the devouring guests — the heir learning what inheritance costs.
